summary: Tisdale tower listed at Timmins; firelookout.ca says it appears standing, and a still-standing list says its cupola was removed and it is used as a communications tower.

facts.status_note: Cupola removed; now used as a communications tower, according to a still-standing list.

evidence.supports: Listed as Tisdale Tower at Schumacher
Asterisk means cupola removed and tower now used as communications tower
MNR decided as of 2013 to remove many of these towers
evidence.quote: The Ontario MNR has decided, as of 2013, to remove many of these still standing towers.

evidence.supports: MNR no longer maintains these towers; visitors asked not to climb
evidence.quote: The MNR no longer maintains them so please refrain from climbing.

notes_for_editor: Brief has no local_unit and the record's county is null; no fetched source names the district. Firelookout.ca gives Timmins and the still-standing list gives Schumacher; the sources do not show these are one site. No build date, design, height or agency found. A Facebook group post titled 'Schumacher (Timmins) Fire Observation Tower' appeared in search results but its text could not be read, so it is not cited and may or may not be this tower.
